bibl.title: Shaping a city and its defenses: fortifications of Hellenistic Berenike Trogodytika.
bibl.seg: Marek Woźniak, Shaping a city and its defenses: fortifications of Hellenistic Berenike Trogodytika.
Iwona Zych (ed.), Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/2. Research on the Red Sea (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 43-60, figg.
bibl.note: Sections of a thick wall constructed of gypsum anhydrite blocks on a wide foundation were recorded in the northern part of the site. Remains of a well-preserved early Hellenistic fortified city gate were uncovered in the north-western part: it was built of gypsum anhydrite blocks and chunks of coral, and had to the east a series of shallow basins interconnected by pipes made of truncated necks of early Hellenistic amphorae, probably to collect rainwater.
